competitorNotes: Etsy uses 'body doubling' for ADHD/AuDHD planners, worksheets and a focus app, but no physical body doubling signs surfaced; the sign is a gap.
ADHD desk/door signs on Etsy are mostly humorous 'do not disturb' or 'overstimulated' styles.
Most shared-project results (sensory room, calm corner, neurodiversity decor) are digital printables; stating 'physical poster print' separates this listing.
Amazon ADHD decor is dominated by gag desk plaques and metal 'superpower' signs; nothing framed as a body doubling or shared-workspace sign.

research.notes: 'body doubling sign' did not appear as an Etsy /market phrase; chosen because 'body doubling' is the poster's printed subject and Etsy body-doubling products show buyers use the term. Unverified as a search volume; supporting tags lean on indexed ADHD desk/deep work phrases. Listing pages were not reachable from this environment (WebFetch blocked); evidence is from search results only. No priceRange: snippets mixed digital downloads with physical signs and did not separate physical poster prices.
